apk_origin: OWASP MASTG / Crackmes / Android / Level_01 (vendor: Bernhard Mueller, Vantage Point Security)
scope_note: MASTG corpus baseline — 외부 ground truth로 PleOS pipeline 정확도 측정용. 본 APK의 모든 java source (6 files) 직접 분석 (priority filtering 우회). configs/keywords.yaml 카테고리 enum (crypto/network/permission/intent/hardcoded/reflection_dynamic) 안에 들어가는 vuln만 보고. anti-tamper(root/debug detection) findings는 별도 scope extension으로 카테고리 enum 확장 시 보고.

findings.title: Hardcoded AES key + ciphertext in verification routine
findings.rationale: 16-byte AES key (hex literal) and the ciphertext (base64 literal) baked into the verify routine. Any reverse-engineer can extract both, decrypt the ciphertext, and recover the secret string used for input validation. Static-string secret recovery is the canonical OWASP MASTG MASVS-CRYPTO-1 / MASVS-STORAGE-2 violation pattern.

findings.title: Crypto exception detail logged via Log.d
findings.rationale: Crypto error message reaches logcat, which is readable by other apps holding READ_LOGS or by vendor diagnostics on production builds. Information disclosure of internal crypto state.

findings.title: AES default mode (Cipher.getInstance("AES") = ECB without IV)
findings.rationale: On Android, Cipher.getInstance("AES") defaults to AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding — deterministic block cipher mode without IV. Identical plaintext blocks produce identical ciphertext blocks; pattern leakage. Note that the SecretKeySpec constructor's algorithm string "AES/ECB/PKCS7Padding" is ignored by the JCE provider — only the Cipher.getInstance argument matters. MASTG MASVS-CRYPTO-1.

negative_confirmations: MainActivity 진입 검증 (root/debug detection)은 카테고리 enum 안에 매칭자 없음 → stage1 보고 제외 (scope extension).
ContentProvider / BroadcastReceiver / Service 정의 없음 (Activity 단일 + utility 클래스만).
